parameters.query:
INSERT INTO spend_counter (workflow_key, window_start, cost_usd, call_count)
VALUES ($1, date_trunc($2, now()), $3, 1)
ON CONFLICT (workflow_key, window_start) DO UPDATE
  SET cost_usd = spend_counter.cost_usd + EXCLUDED.cost_usd,
      call_count = spend_counter.call_count + 1,
      updated_at = now()
RETURNING cost_usd, call_count, window_start;

INSERT INTO breaker_state (workflow_key, state, reason, tripped_at, tripped_by)
VALUES ($1, 'open', $2, now(), $3)
ON CONFLICT (workflow_key) DO UPDATE
  SET state = 'open', reason = EXCLUDED.reason, tripped_at = now(),
      tripped_by = EXCLUDED.tripped_by, reset_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
RETURNING workflow_key, state, reason, tripped_at;
